Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human JAK3. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name = 'JAK3' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
